preconditions.description: The number of values to be inserted must be between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(value, int) for value in values)
preconditions.description: All values to be inserted must be integers.

preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, AVLNode)
preconditions.description: The root of the AVL tree must be either None or an instance of AVLNode.

postconditions.description: The output must be the inorder traversal of the modified AVL tree.

postconditions.expression: any(value in inorder_traversal(root) for value in values)
postconditions.description: All inserted values must be present in the inorder traversal of the modified AVL tree.
